## 1. Biography & Academic Profile

Adiel Emilson is an undergraduate student and researcher in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence at the Universidade Federal da Paraíba (UFPB) in João Pessoa, Paraíba, Brazil.

His work bridges deep learning models and low-level computational execution: combining PyTorch neural networks, native C++ compute kernels via pybind11, and real-time interactive 3D web visualizations.

- **Full Name**: Adiel Emilson (known online as Adiells)
- **Role**: Data Science & AI Student and Researcher
- **Degree**: B.S. in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (Ciência de Dados e Inteligência Artificial) — UFPB
- **Location**: João Pessoa, Paraíba, Brazil (UTC-3)
- **Website**: https://adiels.me/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/adiells
- **LinkedIn**: https://linkedin.com/in/adielemilson
- **Email**: adielenilson@gmail.com

## 3. Technical Skills & Architecture Layers

### Layer 01: Machine Learning & Computer Vision
- **Frameworks & Tools**: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, YOLO
- **Specializations**: Deep Neural Networks, Audio DSP & STFT (Short-Time Fourier Transform), Spectral Audio Processing, Neuroevolution & Genetic Algorithms, Real-Time Inference Pipelines.

### Layer 02: High-Performance & Robotics Systems
- **Languages & Frameworks**: C++17, pybind11, Python 3.11+, ROS (Robot Operating System)
- **Specializations**: Native computational kernels, low-latency similarity & matrix computation, Python/C++ FFI interoperability, deterministic control loops, embedded robotics perception.

### Layer 03: Data Engineering & Interactive Systems
- **Tools**: Pandas, NumPy, FastAPI, Docker, Linux, React 19, Three.js, Vite
- **Specializations**: Structured data ingestion, statistical modeling, model serving REST APIs, SSE telemetry, high-performance 3D web previewers.

## 4. Key Projects & Systems

### Music2Chart (Live at https://music2chart.adiels.me/)
- **Description**: Automated high-fidelity audio-to-chart workstation for rhythm games Clone Hero and YARG (Yet Another Rhythm Game).
- **Core Pipeline**: Audio Ingestion (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG) → Neural Stem Separation & Spectral Audio DSP → 192 PPQ Dynamic Beat Grids & Game Design Heuristics → Real-Time Three.js 3D Highway Preview → Tournament-Grade `.chart` and `.sng` (SongBinary v1) Package Export.
- **Technologies**: PyTorch, FastAPI, Python 3.11+, React 19, Three.js, Docker, Google Cloud Run, GitHub Pages.

### Snake AI & Neuroevolution
- **Description**: Autonomous spatial navigation and decision-making system using genetic algorithms and feedforward neural controllers.
- **Technologies**: Python, Genetic Algorithms, Neural Optimization.

### High-Performance Vector Recommendation Kernel
- **Description**: C++17 compute engine exposed to Python via pybind11 for sub-millisecond vector similarity calculations and matrix operations.
- **Technologies**: C++17, pybind11, SIMD/Cache-aware data structures.

### Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Perception
- **Description**: ROS-integrated visual tracking and obstacle avoidance pipeline for mobile robotics.
- **Technologies**: ROS, C++, YOLO, OpenCV.
